title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_11515__PART_1_)
clause_1_scope: 1. Scope — This standard (Part 2) covers fixed metallised polycarbonate capacitors, tubular, non-hermetically sealed in non-metal case, insulated, tape wrapped and filled or moulded type, axial lead configuration.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Fixed Metallised Polycarbonate Film Dielectric Capacitors, Part 2: Type FCCM 1

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
